messages:
sam: Heads up — planning a tf apply for release-2026.03 during the 18:00 UTC change window. Targeting network + iam diffs only. Will pin provider versions before apply.
maria: SGTM. Which providers are we pinning?
sam: aws provider -> 4.56.0, terraform -> 1.6.4 in the repo. I pushed a tiny branch that adds the required version constraints. https://git.redwood/repo/infra/+/pin-providers
akshay: Deploy-bot will run preflight? I can do a manual plan if we want extra eyes.
deploy-bot: Preflight started for branch pin-providers at 2026-03-21T17:40:12Z. Running `terraform plan -var-file=release-2026-03.tfvars` in workspace release-2026.
sam: Plan looks clean for core VPC and route53. IAM has 3 updates (two policy narrowings, one role trust change).
maria: Policy narrowings are non-breaking but double-check the service principal list for the role trust change.
akshay: I'll post the relevant diff snippet: ```diff
resource "aws_iam_role" "redwood_merge_bot" {
  assume_role_policy = jsonencode({
-   "Service": "codebuild.amazonaws.com"
+   "Service": "codebuild.amazonaws.com, ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com"
  })
}
```
akshay: That role change enables ECS tasks to assume, intentional for the rollout.
deploy-bot: NOTE: State lock check OK. No concurrent applies detected.
sam: Plan approval: @maria @akshay please ack so I can schedule the apply at 18:05 UTC. We want serial-apply across accounts.
maria: Ack. I validated the principal list, looks fine. :thumbsup:
akshay: Ack. I'll be on call for rollback if needed.
devops-oncall: I'll be standing by and will watch deploybot alerts. Set rollback signal thresholds in release notes?
sam: Add these in release notes: if >5% packet loss between private subnets or IAM failures in auth logs spike >10% in 10m -> rollback. Also set deploybot circuit-breaker to 10% error rate for 5m.
maria: Adding to release notes doc now. Also setting a temporary route53 TTL increase to 60s for quick rollback.
akshay: Apply command I'll run at 18:05: ```bash
git checkout pin-providers && terraform init -upgrade && terraform workspace select release-2026 && terraform apply -auto-approve -parallelism=1
```
sam: Run with -parallelism=1 and with `TF_LOG=TRACE` only if troubleshooting; avoid verbose logs to cloudwatch during happy path.
deploy-bot: Starting scheduled apply in 10 minutes. Will break into account waves: customer-prod-1, customer-prod-2, common-services. Each account wave will block for 2m verification.
devops-oncall: Reminder: KMS rotation window closed at 17:00, so no key material changes should happen. If we see KMS errors, abort immediately and contact security.
maria: Quick checklist before apply: 1) state snapshot saved 2) backup tfstate copied to s3://infra-backups/2026-03-21/3467890123.tfstate 3) cloudtrail filter for IAM events live 4) dashboards pinned
sam: Done: snapshot + backup completed.
akshay: I'm executing the apply now on the first wave (customer-prod-1). Pasting short logs: ```
Apply complete! Resources: 2 added, 3 changed, 0 destroyed.
 - aws_route_table.private updated
 - aws_iam_policy.restrict updated
```
akshay: Running post-apply smoke checks — internal ping, service token exchange, STS assume-role test.
akshay: Smoke OK for customer-prod-1. moving to customer-prod-2.
deploy-bot: Wave 2 completed. Wave 3 (common-services) scheduled in 3m.
maria: I'm seeing increased 502s on the internal auth gateway (3.6% -> 7.9%) after wave 2; investigating logs.
akshay: Can you share a relevant stacktrace?
maria: Snippet: "AccessDenied: user: arn:aws:sts::123456:assumed-role/redwood-ops cannot perform: iam:PassRole on resource: arn:aws:iam::123456:role/ecs-task-role" — looks like role policy did not include PassRole for ecs-task-role.
sam: That aligns with the IAM role diff; passrole was unintentionally omitted in one policy. We need rollback for common-services to restore previous policy.
akshay: Proposed rollback steps: 1) Pin state to previous workspace snapshot, 2) apply restore branch `revert/iam-passrole` to common-services only, 3) verify auth gateway 0-1% 502s.
deploy-bot: Abort signal received for wave 3 at 18:18:07Z. Initiating rollback lane for common-services.
devops-oncall: Executing rollback apply now. Command: `terraform apply -target=module.iam.aws_iam_policy.restrict -auto-approve` on revert/iam-passrole branch.
akshay: Rollback apply complete. Changes: policy updated to include iam:PassRole.
maria: Verification: Auth gateway 502s dropped back to 0.9% within 90s. STS assume-role tests pass.
sam: Good catch — thanks team. We'll document root cause: missing PassRole in the narrowed policy for ecs-task-role. Add a regression test for passrole in postmortem.
maria: I'll update release notes and mark this release as partial: network changes applied, IAM rolled back. Notifying product and security.
akshay: Postmortem note: add an automated lint rule in our CI that fails PRs removing iam:PassRole where ecs-task-role is in use.
sam: Agreed. Closing thread after docs updated. Thanks all. :raised_hands:
